we have published a linked data dataset for exposing the GDPR and its text extensions, and we have provided a mapping from the DPD to GDPR for linking related legislations.

providing an online resource for the GDPR that can be reused in various applications related to compliance and research.
providing a linked data resource that can be used by organisations to measure the scope and degree of solutions for compliance towards the GDPR.

providing a linked data representation of the GDPR text and its related legislations, which is a necessary step in order to provide a common ground to consolidate research and innovation in GDPR compliance.

GDPRtEXT provides a resource that can help in linking and comparing solutions and research approaches to GDPR.
the dataset is a useful resource to link and compare solutions to GDPR compliance.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
GDPRtEXT provides a linked resource for GDPR that enables the linking of research, solutions, and approaches to the relevant text in the GDPR.

we provide a way to link GDPR with the relevant research in a way that can be used to consolidate the solutions for compliance towards GDPR and the DPD, and also to reuse existing research and approaches.
GDPRtEXT provides a way to link together the various approaches addressing the GDPR and to link them to the relevant text.

the use of linked data can help in the development of a data protection ecosystem that can assist in the development, adoption and evaluation of GDPR compliance solutions.
the GDPRtEXT resource provides a foundation for the development of tools and services that can help in the compliance of organisations with the GDPR and the comparison of existing approaches.
